---

### 1. **Logarithm Domain Conditions**

- The inner logarithm $ \log(x - 2) $ is defined only when:
  $$
  x - 2 > 0 \Rightarrow x > 2.
  $$

- The outer logarithm $ \log(2 - \log(x - 2)) $ is defined only when:

  2 - \log(x - 2) > 0 \Rightarrow \log(x - 2) < 2.
  $$

  x - 2 < 10^2 = 100 \Rightarrow x < 102.
  $$

So, combining these two conditions:
$$
x > 2 \quad \text{and} \quad x < 102 \Rightarrow x \in (2, 102).
$$
